target.statement: AUC-ROC of COD on the Audiology dataset with 5 labeled outliers (value 0.877 in Table 3)

compute.basis: COD is a simple fuzzy-rough algorithm with O(mn^2) complexity; Audiology has only 226 samples and 69 attributes, so a single run takes seconds on CPU; the main cost is downloading the dataset and implementing the method from the paper (code may be available but not verified).

title: Consistency-guided semi-supervised outlier detection in heterogeneous data using fuzzy rough sets
